what: Five corrections to the deterministic CWO scanner, made AFTER the post-wave re-scan had already reported candidates. Changing a test after seeing its results is exactly the move that can launder a failure into a pass, so the change is recorded here with its justification, both scans are retained, and the pre-scan was re-run under the corrected tool so the parity comparison is like-for-like.

corrections.change: grammatical person/number labels exempt from the universals screen
corrections.ground: 'first-person' was already exempt as morphology; 'first-plural' and 'third-singular' are the same construction. Consistency, not outcome.

corrections.change: a digit-bearing count may carry up to two words between the digit and its unit; sites/hits admitted as units
corrections.ground: The order requires 'a DIGIT and a unit word' in the sentence, not adjacency. '0 samekh verses' and '22 marked verses' satisfy the order and failed the regex.

corrections.change: verbatim quoted runs are removed before the universals screen
corrections.ground: The order's scope is the row's own claims. Words inside a curly-quoted run belong to the translation, and E-15 requires that run to stay verbatim; a screen that forces editing a quotation would set two campaign laws against each other.

corrections.change: the quotation exclusion applies at FIELD level, before the sentence split
corrections.ground: A quotation regularly spans a sentence boundary, so a per-sentence strip misses its second half. Same principle, correct placement.

corrections.change: CWO-4's 'name the in-span verse' conjunct, where the form has NO in-span occurrence, is satisfied by naming a verse of the span
corrections.ground: The order says device_notes must name BOTH the in-span and the out-of-span verse, which presupposes an in-span occurrence. Where the sweep puts every occurrence outside the span, no in-span verse carries the form and the conjunct as written is unsatisfiable. An unsatisfiable test is a defective test.

corrections.what: CWO-1's token predicate was narrowed in _cwo_scan.py: cwo1_verdict(key) implements B3-1's three rules (R1 mark-layer token under any prefix; R2 letter/mark homonym outside the acrostic namespace; R3 letter/mark homonym paired with mark wording) in place of the issued flat token list.
corrections.why: NOT a scanner defect and NOT the orchestrator's judgement: this change executes boss ruling B3-1 (2026-09-07, SP/Lam/reviews/boss_lam_b3.json), which narrowed CWO-1 after the second-generation catch found that the same string names a tier-1 acrostic LETTER and a tier-3 parashah MARK, and the campaign's own hazard law forbids conflating those layers.
corrections.authority: boss ruling B3-1 by lam_boss_b3_a1 (claude-fable-5-1); the issued order stands unedited in reviews/boss_lam_b1.json
corrections.how_it_differs_from_corrections_1_to_5: those five were corrections to a scanner that was misreading its own order; this one implements a change to the ORDER itself, made by the boss, and is recorded here because a reader comparing scans across the wave must see every reason the tool's verdicts moved
corrections.self_test: 29 vectors in _cwo_scan.py exercise R1/R2/R3 and their negatives
corrections.recorded_late_note: this entry was written during the OW-6 fix round after the stage-2 final checker found the scan-correction record listed five corrections and not this one

what_did_NOT_change: A genuine undisclosed seam adjacency, a genuine bare exclusivity claim, and a genuine missing ketiv/qere disclosure all still fail the arms. Six such residuals survived the corrections and were sent to a bounded correction round rather than waived.
parity_rule_unchanged: cwo_parity.v1.json is GREEN only when every exact arm returns 0 over the final corpus and every ordered row carries an author disposition. The correction round exists to reach that, not to redefine it.
amendment_note: a sixth entry was appended during the OW-6 fix round: it records a change to the ORDER made by boss ruling B3-1, not a correction of the scanner's own reading. Entries 1-5 are unedited.
